description: Bivio velvet — Colore: Terra & copper Collezione: Lucis Codice: 3B05146 Materiale: 9% Cashmere, 91% Cotton Disegno: Modern Scala: Extra Small Altezza: 136.5 cm Rapporto: 1.5 cm × 3 cm Toni: Orange BIVIO (Italian for crossroads) translates the idea of life's choices into a small-scale geometric textile. Its interlocking linework creates a complex maze to trace across the surface, with simple shapes suggesting a basket-weave structure that is both precise and quietly hypnotic. In the CROSSROADS collection, BIVIO is rendered in 100% cotton — a version that emphasizes the clarity and graphic quality of the design over the textural depth of its LUCIS velvet counterpart. The cotton ground gives the pattern a sharper visual edge, making it particularly effective for upholstery applications where the geometric structure needs to hold across both flat and curved surfaces. Available in blue-grey, Byzantium, and platinum monotone colorways.
